description: Read per-skill mastery from the learning system (Step 18): your own per-skill mastery rows (rolling-accuracy/BKT estimates over QA signals), or — with projectId + asOwner — the buyer-side per-worker mastery view for a project you own. Requires learning:read scope and the public API learning feature.

asOwner.description: Set true with projectId to read the buyer-side per-worker view.

projectId.description: When set with asOwner and you own the project, returns per-worker mastery; otherwise filters your own per-skill mastery by project.

name: opentrain_learning_mastery
